feeds.title: Plant Based Dads Blog
feeds.description: I am Joey Troxel, For the last few years, I have spent every day learning how to eat a more whole food, plant based and mostly unprocessed diet. I post articles on whole food plant based cooking, health, and family. Come along on the journey with us and let's get healthy together.

feeds.title: That Vegan Dad Blog
feeds.description: I'm Jack. I am a father and husband and I have been vegan since 2017. My idea behind That Vegan Dad is to show everyone that adopting a vegan lifestyle can be easy and highly accessible for just about anyone! I update with weekly vegan taste test reviews, grocery hauls and plenty of tips and tricks to assist vegans.

feeds.title: The Plant Based Dad
feeds.description: Welcome to the plant based dad recipe site. These recipes are completely vegan friendly made from everyday supermarket plant-based items. Each recipe has a set of photos showing every step of the recipe along with a complete step by step instruction and ingredient list.

feeds.title: Dad Goes Vegan
feeds.description: Dad Goes Vegan publishes articles on everything related to vegan and cruelty free products including cosmetics and preservatives and chemicals added to food along with vegan recipes and lifestyle.

feeds.title: Lean Green Dad Blog
feeds.description: Our blog is here to help you guide your plant-based family by learning about the best vegan products, plant-based support, and inspiration to help your vegan family thrive. Cory is a husband, father of three & vegan athlete helping busy families eat more plant-based foods! Lean Green DAD, is a lifestyle blog about food, family and fun to promote a healthy balance of plant-based nutrition, fitness and overall wellness.

feeds.title: The Vegan Dad Movement
feeds.description: Vegan Dad is Lee Weissman, a five-year vegan, eleven- time marathon runner, and father of four. Always passionate about cooking, he thoughtfully incorporated plant-based ingredients into his repertoire, experimenting with a number of culinary traditions from around the globe.
